outcome: large for gestational age at birth
sensitivity of ultrasound in predicting large for gestational age
false positive rate of ultrasound in predicting large for gestational age
positive predictive value of ultrasound in predicting large for gestational age
cohort: 26,527 pregnant women in the West Midlands, United Kingdom
finding: Late third-trimester ultrasound estimation of fetal weight has a good ability to identify and predict large for gestational age at birth, especially when using a customized growth standard and when the ultrasound is performed for a suspected large fetus.
